TC-02/S22.title: Real camera capture on iPhone and Android
TC-02/S22.detail: Device-only: needs a physical iPhone / Android build pointed at the local stack, a printed census and a camera; not run (brief 4: record as Manual). Related candidate from the 2026-10-15 Android emulator run: N9 ('Take Photo or Choose Image' opens the photo picker, never the camera, even with camera permission granted) and N10 (camera permission denied: the button does nothing). Even on a device, every read would currently come back empty on dev (B01).
